environment: Owned ARM64 Android API 36 emulator, Linux X11 1920x1080 fixture, Sunshine software encoder
transport: Private test-only TCP/UDP loopback relays; not a LAN/WAN latency result

tests.name: host-manager-save-card
tests.detail: Adding a host saves one card and returns to the independent manager without connecting.

tests.name: isolated-input
tests.detail: Small pointer movement affects only the owned :21 display; production :10 is unchanged.

tests.name: pad-held-buttons-wheel
tests.detail: Both held mouse buttons move remote targets and release in pairs; the center wheel scrolls.

tests.name: portrait-panel-layout
tests.detail: Trackpad is below the desktop and above Chat; closing it returns 176dp to Chat while the composer stays at the bottom.

tests.name: zoomed-one-finger-pan
tests.detail: A one-finger slide on the zoomed desktop pans the local viewport without clicking or dragging remote targets.

tests.name: direct-system-ime
tests.detail: The system IME opens directly from the desktop keyboard button. The opt-in native test sent the exact Chinese/Latin token to the isolated GTK entry through the real 200ms scheduler.

tests.name: reading-position-preserved
tests.detail: Appending a new source message keeps the same earlier messages visible and leaves return-to-latest available.

tests.name: history-reaches-first-message
tests.detail: The actual app reaches QA0000 from a 651-message / 5851-record source. Continuous gestures across page boundaries do not open an error dialog.

tests.name: history-forwards-to-latest
tests.detail: The app explicitly loads five newer pages after older pages have been evicted, reaching final QA0650.

tests.name: history-return-latest
tests.detail: Return-to-latest leaves the reading window and resumes following new messages.

tests.name: fullscreen-mouse-draggable
tests.detail: Collapsed 48dp touch target (32dp visual) can be dragged into the left video letterbox area.

tests.name: fullscreen-close-reachable
tests.detail: Expanded mouse keeps its separate 48dp close button on screen at the workspace edge.

tests.name: source-coordinate-mapping
tests.detail: A center tap after 2x zoom and a 110×40 local pan hits source coordinates (905,520), using the same inverse viewport transform.
